name: Open public pages and navigate between separate routes
description: Verifies the foundation's public information architecture opens distinct pages and remains navigable.
steps: Open About, Our Mission, Governance, and Transparency from the navigation
Open the Donate page and return Home
expected: Each menu item opens its own page content and the page begins at the top.

name: Submit donor interest without accepting money
description: Verifies a visitor can register interest while the site clearly states that payment processing is not active.
steps: Enter a valid name, email, interest, and message
expected: The enquiry is saved and acknowledged as interest only; no payment is requested or processed.

name: Submit corporate partnership enquiry
description: Verifies a company representative can submit a partnership enquiry from a mobile device.
steps: Enter name, email, organization, collaboration type, and message
expected: A success acknowledgement appears and the enquiry is stored for authorized administrator review.

name: Restrict administration and review saved enquiries
description: Verifies anonymous visitors cannot access private enquiries and the authorized administrator can review records.
steps: Open the Administrator link while signed out
Attempt to access the overview without signing in
Sign in with the authorized administrator account
Review donor and partnership enquiry lists
expected: Unauthenticated and non-allowlisted users are denied; the approved administrator sees stored enquiries and can sign out.

name: Protect patients and avoid unverified organizational claims
covers: no fabricated leadership or registration claims
description: Verifies patient and donor safeguards remain visible on mobile.
steps: Review the closed-application and privacy notices
expected: The website does not request sensitive patient data, fabricate registration or leadership details, or accept funds through unverified channels.
